sloka: अम्ब सम्हृत्य सम्भारान् दुःखम् हृदि निगृह्य च ।वनवासकृता बुद्धिर्मम धर्म्यानुवर्त्यताम् ॥२-२१-४९॥
transliteration: amba samhṛtya sambhārān duḥkham hṛdi nigṛhya ca ।vanavāsakṛtā buddhirmama dharmyānuvartyatām ॥2-21-49॥

translations.english: O mother in withdrawing the articles (for consecration) and also in subduing the sorrow in your heart approve of my plan to dwell in the forest.
